rationale: Two-corpus gate wave 2026-09 (clojure:java APersistentVector.SubVector). JAO1: JLS 8.4.8 — @Override is a compile-time check, not a requirement; un-annotated instance methods with matching signatures still override (analyzer was annotation-gated, silently dropping most real overrides in annotation-light codebases; grails's annotation-heavy code masked it). JAO2: same-name-different-signature is an OVERLOAD, never an override — the name-only override truth fabricated SubVector.nth -> APersistentVector.nth for nth(int) vs nth(int, Object); both sides are now signature-aware. Private ancestor methods are never overridden (JLS 8.4.8.1).
